cvEn:
Yuval Ben-Horin, son of Sara and Yosef, was born on the sixth of Av 5718 (23 July 1958) in Tel Aviv. He attended the Gordon Elementary School in Givatayim. His mother passed away when he was a child. He then moved to live at Kibbutz Gal'on, where he completed his elementary and secondary education.

Yuval was drafted into the IDF in early November 1976 and was assigned to the Armored Corps. There he completed the combat training course and the tank commanders' course. His last position during his regular service was Operations NCO (Mash"ak Mivtzaim). His discharge certificate states that he was "a quiet, dedicated and very responsible soldier. He showed clear integrity and diligence." During his service he received the Operational Service Ribbon.

After completing his regular service, he was called up for reserve duty. Yuval fell during his service on the thirteenth of Av 5749 (14 August 1989) and was laid to rest in the military cemetery at Kiryat Shaul. He left behind a father and a brother, Alon.

In a letter of condolence to the family, his commander wrote: "Yuval was a dedicated soldier and a devoted friend, loved by his comrades, always glad to help and to lend a shoulder to the other soldiers in the unit. All the unit's commanders grieve his loss."
